title: herdr-engineering release.json
description: The machine-readable record of one release, attached to its GitHub release by .woodpecker/release.yml (docs/releases.md). Consumers (herdr-fleet init, herdr-fleet pins update) pin image.repository@image.digest; no tag appears here because no mutable tag is trusted.

version.description: The release version X.Y.Z; its git tag is vX.Y.Z and equals pyproject.toml [project].version.

repository.description: Registry repository without tag or digest, e.g. ghcr.io/berlinguyinca/herdr-engineering.

digest.description: Digest of the multi-arch image index (linux/amd64, linux/arm64), never a per-architecture manifest.

commit.description: Full git sha of the tagged commit the image was built from.
